summary: NaaS Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement of 24,024,022,400 Class A ordinary shares (7,507,507 ADSs) with warrants for an additional 22,880,022,400 shares, raising US$25 million gross at US$0.001041 per share (US$3.33 per ADS). The warrants have a US$3.4965 per ADS exercise price and expire August 31, 2031. The buyer includes related-party Newlink Envision Limited, an affiliate of controlling shareholder Newlink; the transaction was approved by the Audit Committee. The closing occurred August 31, 2026, increasing Newlink's voting power to 57.71%. While structured as a capital raise, the related-party nature and shareholder dilution suggest potential capital returns context; watch for further strategic moves.
